title: Nexus CoreCharacterTransitionRequest
description: Direct Character lifecycle transition request. Old activity tokens are invalid after transition; a no-op transition retires no sessions and advances no epoch.

character_id.description: Character ID: lowercase chr_ prefix and exactly 32 hex characters.

target_status.description: Lifecycle target; archived or restored active.

expected_revision.description: Optimistic concurrency revision of the Character record.
